segments.name: Banking
segments.description: Provides commercial, residential and consumer lending, deposit products, and related banking services to consumer, commercial, non-profit and municipal customers in southern New England.
segments.evidence: The Corporation manages its operations through two reportable business segments, consisting of Banking and Wealth Management Services.

segments.name: Wealth Management Services
segments.description: Provides investment management, financial planning, personal trust and estate services, and institutional trust and custody services to personal and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: We provide a broad range of wealth management services to personal and institutional clients.

revenueModel.text: The company earns interest on loans and securities, fees from deposit and treasury services, mortgage banking revenues, and asset-based fees from wealth management clients.
revenueModel.evidence: Wealth management revenues represent our largest source of noninterest income.
